messages:
Alex H: Quick heads-up — finalizing release notes for 0.29.2. Need a short internal blurb + pin for Monday 09:00 PT. Can we lock the canary and confirm rollback owners?
Maria C: I can draft the internal blurb. Will keep it 1 line + 3 bullets for ops.
Devon R: Canary window: 08:00 PT -> 08:30 PT staging. We'll watch latency, error rate, and model perf.
Jen P: I'll be primary for deploy rollback. Samir, you good to own DB fallback/feature-flag revert?
Samir K: Yep. I'll prepare DB revert steps and make sure toggles are independent. Add me to oncall steps.
Alex H: Maria — include a note about model pinning: prod pinned to v2.1.4, canary runs v2.2-beta. Also call out deploybot cues and quiet window.
Maria C: Draft: 
"Deploy Monday 09:00 PT: 0.29.2 — pins prod to v2.1.4; staging canary of v2.2-beta at 08:00 PT. If canary green, full rollout at 09:00 PT."
Devon R: Small edit: change "pins prod to v2.1.4" -> "pins prod to v2.1.4 and enables v2.2-beta canary"
Maria C: Updated.
Alex H: Devon, post the deploybot commands we plan to run so ops can copy/paste.
Devon R: Staging canary: ```/deploy start --env staging --version 0.29.2 --canary 10% --note "canary v2.2-beta"```
Devon R: Prod rollout (if green): ```/deploy start --env production --version 0.29.2 --pin v2.1.4 --note "pin prod, canary v2.2-beta"```
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued. Run `/deploy confirm 6001112223` within 15m to proceed.
oncall-bot: Oncall ping: @Jen P infra, @Samir K db.
Jen P: Monitoring thresholds: abort if token errors >1% OR p50 latency +50ms (vs baseline). I'll cut abort and notify #incidents.
Samir K: DB migration? If separate, we won't tie it to rollout. I'll have revert commands ready and doc the feature-flag toggle.
Alex H: Maria — add rollback bullets (commands + owners) to the blurb and a link to the runbook.
Maria C: Added rollback snippet: 
- Canary fail: `/deploy abort --env staging --reason "canary regressions"` and notify #incidents.
- Prod rollback: `/deploy rollback --env production --to-version 0.29.1` — primary: Jen P; DB fallback: Samir K.
Devon R: I'll also append a quick smoke checklist in the notes: p50/p95 latency, error rate, KV-cache hitrate, model perplexity check, freshness of embeddings.
Alex H: Good. Final: Maria, post the internal blurb to #eng-releases at 08:50 PT, pin til 10:30 PT. Keep it short.
Maria C: Ready to post at 08:50 PT: 
"Deploy Monday 09:00 PT: 0.29.2 (pins prod to v2.1.4). Staging canary 08:00 PT (v2.2-beta). Rollback owners: Jen P (deploy), Samir K (DB). Runbook: https://go/runbooks/0.29.2"
Jen P: LGTM :thumbsup:
Samir K: LGTM.
Alex H: I'll confirm `/deploy confirm` once the blurb is posted.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary start 08:00 PT, auto-check 08:20 PT, confirm window open until 08:40 PT.
